reuse.why: Introduces getBulkBudgetCategories and reuses getCategoryAverage/setBudget, but setBulkNMonthAvg re-writes setNMonthAvg's average-and-sign logic instead of calling it, and copyPreviousMonth does not use the new selection.

duplication.why: The three averaging actions are consolidated, but the exclusion rule exists twice (SQL+filter in getBulkBudgetCategories and hand-written hidden/#fixed/goal_def checks in copyPreviousMonth) and the expense sign flip is repeated.

placement.why: All selection logic stays in budget/actions.ts and the new handler is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on month-wide actions; unformatted long lines and widening getBudgetData's query/type are slightly beyond what is needed.

maintainability.why: Most actions share one category selection, but a future exclusion must be added in two different forms (SQL in the selector, JS checks in copyPreviousMonth) and the hidden rule is split between a SQL flag and a caller check.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts copyPreviousMonth applies hidden, #fixed and goal_def exclusions itself over getBudgetData rows instead of using getBulkBudgetCategories; setBulkNMonthAvg bypasses setNMonthAvg

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth re-expresses the getBulkBudgetCategories exclusions as early returns; setBulkNMonthAvg reshapes setNMonthAvg's body inline

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories gains includeHiddenCategories; copyPreviousMonth keeps its own exclusion branches (hidden flag, isFixedGroupNote, goal_def) instead of calling the shared selection
